title: List of Aizoaceae of South Africa

{{short description|List of flowering plants in the family Aizoaceae recorded from South Africa}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}
[[Aizoaceae]] <small>Martynov, ''nom. cons.''</small> (fig-marigold family) is a large [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] of [[dicotyledon]]ous [[flowering plant]]s in the [[order (biology)|order]] [[Caryophyllales]] containing 135 currently accepted [[Genus|genera]] and about 1800 [[species]].<ref>{{Cite book|title=Illustrated Handbook of Succulent Plants|last=Hartmann|first=HEK|publisher=Springer|year=2001|location=Berlin, Germany}}</ref> They are commonly known as ice plants, carpet weeds or vygies.

23,420 species of vascular plant have been recorded in South Africa, making it the sixth most species-rich country in the world and the most species-rich country on the African continent. Of these, 153 species are considered to be threatened.<ref name="Butler 2019" /> Nine [[biome]]s have been described in South Africa: [[Fynbos]], Succulent [[Karoo]], [[desert]], [[Nama Karoo]], [[grassland]], [[savanna]], [[Albany thickets]], the [[Indian Ocean coastal belt]], and [[forest]]s.<ref name="PlantZAfrica" />

The 2018 [[South African National Biodiversity Institute]]'s [[National Biodiversity Assessment]] plant checklist lists 35,130 taxa in the phyla [[Anthocerotophyta]] (hornworts (6)), [[Anthophyta]] (flowering plants (33534)), [[Mosses|Bryophyta]] (mosses (685)), [[Cycadophyta]] (cycads (42)), [[Lycopodiophyta]] (Lycophytes(45)), [[Marchantiophyta]] (liverworts (376)), [[Pinophyta]] (conifers (33)), and [[Pteridophyta]] (cryptogams (408)).<ref name="Plants 2018" />

169 [[Genus (biology)|genera]] are represented in the literature. Listed [[Taxon|taxa]] include [[species]], [[subspecies]], [[variety (botany)|varieties]], and [[Form (botany)|forms]] as recorded, some of which have subsequently been allocated to other taxa as [[Synonym (taxonomy)|synonyms]], in which cases the accepted taxon is appended to the listing.<ref name="Plants 2018" /> Multiple entries under alternative names reflect [[taxonomic revision]] over time.
